fact: Forty-five percent of patients in the EMPEROR-Preserved trial had a BMI of ≥30 kg/m2.
quote: Forty-five percent had a BMI of ≥30 kg/m2.

fact: Empagliflozin showed a consistent treatment effect versus placebo on the primary outcome (HHF or CV death) across all BMI categories.
fact_zh: 恩格列净在所有BMI类别中对主要结局（HHF或CV死亡）显示出与安慰剂一致的治疗效果。
quote: there was a consistent treatment effect of empagliflozin versus placebo across the BMI categories with no formal interaction (p trend = 0.19) by BMI categories.

fact: Empagliflozin slowed the decline in eGFR compared to placebo, with no difference across BMI categories.
fact_zh: 与安慰剂相比，恩格列净减缓了eGFR的下降，且在不同BMI类别中没有差异。
quote: there was no difference in the effects on secondary outcomes including total HHF (p trend = 0.19), CV death (p trend = 0.20), or eGFR slope with slower declines with empagliflozin regardless of BMI (range 1.12-1.71 ml/min/1.73 m2 relative to placebo, p trend = 0.85 for interaction)

fact: The difference in weight change between empagliflozin and placebo was -2.67 kg in the highest BMI category.
fact_zh: 在最高BMI类别中，恩格列净与安慰剂之间的体重变化差异为-2.67 kg。
quote: difference in weight change between empagliflozin and placebo was -0.59, -1.48, -1.54, -0.87, and - 2.67 kg in the lowest to highest BMI categories

fact: There was a trend toward greater absolute KCCQ-CSS benefit at 32 weeks with empagliflozin at higher BMIs (p = 0.08).
fact_zh: 在较高BMI患者中，恩格列净在32周时显示出更大的绝对KCCQ-CSS获益趋势（p = 0.08）。
quote: there was a trend toward greater absolute KCCQ-CSS benefit at 32 weeks with empagliflozin at higher BMIs (p = 0.08).

fact: Empagliflozin treatment resulted in broadly consistent cardiac effects across the range of BMI in patients with HFpEF.
fact_zh: 恩格列净治疗在HFpEF患者中不同BMI范围内产生了广泛一致的心脏效应。
quote: Empagliflozin treatment resulted in broadly consistent cardiac effects across the range of BMI in patients with HFpEF.

fact: SGLT2i treatment yields benefit in patients with HFpEF regardless of baseline BMI.
fact_zh: 无论基线BMI如何，SGLT2i治疗对HFpEF患者均有获益。
quote: SGLT2i treatment yields benefit in patients with HFpEF regardless of baseline BMI.

fact: The study examined the effects of empagliflozin versus placebo on the primary outcome (HHF or CV death) across five BMI categories.
fact_zh: 该研究考察了恩格列净与安慰剂在五个BMI类别中对主要结局（HHF或CV死亡）的影响。
quote: the effects of empagliflozin versus placebo on the risks for the primary outcome (hospitalization for heart failure [HHF] or cardiovascular [CV] death), change in estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) slopes, change in Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire clinical summary score (KCCQ-CSS), and secondary outcomes across baseline BMI categories (<25 kg/m2, 25 to <30 kg/m2, 30 to <35 kg/m2, 35 to <40 kg/m2 and ≥40 kg/m2) were examined

fact: A meta-analysis was conducted with DELIVER data in addition to EMPEROR-Preserved data.
fact_zh: 除了EMPEROR-Preserved数据外，还使用DELIVER数据进行了荟萃分析。
quote: and a meta-analysis conducted with DELIVER.

fact: The study population included patients with HFpEF.
quote: Whether BMI modifies benefits of sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) requires further investigation.
